description: Get full details for a single video game: description, ratings, Metacritic score, platforms, genres, developers, publishers, ESRB rating, and playtime. Example: get_game({ id: "the-witcher-3-wild-hunt" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own RAWG API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

id.description: RAWG game id or slug, e.g. "3328" or "the-witcher-3-wild-hunt"

name: get_game
